'''Forum post''' is the original Category One Photobucket image from the forum thread; current Photobucket copies carry a Groupsy watermark.<ref name="forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=18282 Reflections Gold, Playtest, Signed, Cards etc] at forum.starwarsccg.org (t=18282). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021002530/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t18282-f87.html Internet Archive]</ref> '''Category One''' is the current buylist photo for that title.<ref name="buylist">[https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398 Category One Games Reflections Gold buylist] (310 titles; pages 1–13). Preserved copies (27 September 2026): [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193408/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=2&sort_by_price=0 p2], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193458/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=4&sort_by_price=0 p4], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193535/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=5&sort_by_price=0 p5], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193653/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=6&sort_by_price=0 p6], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193802/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=8&sort_by_price=0 p8], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927193838/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=9&sort_by_price=0 p9], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927194027/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=11&sort_by_price=0 p11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927194101/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=12&sort_by_price=0 p12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927194212/https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398?page=13&sort_by_price=0 p13]</ref> '''Talaga Drive''' is a high-resolution reconstruction from Andy Talaga's Reflections Gold folder in the MPC print-ready Drive, not a Decipher print file.<ref name="talaga">[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MgdLgCSaNFWN46hCrVhFNDv4fzrJ0jKe Reflections Gold hi-res folder] on Andy Talaga's MPC print-ready Drive. Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210909114037/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MgdLgCSaNFWN46hCrVhFNDv4fzrJ0jKe Internet Archive] (9 September 2021); [https://archive.ph/AIBoA archive.today]</ref> The combo '''The Circle Is Now Complete & Vader's Obsession''' uses the Drive file ''circle is now complete corrected.png''; the standalone Circle row uses ''The Circle Is Now Complete.png''. The sticker misspells Tarkin's title as '''Governer Tarkin''', and the list keeps the printed spelling.<ref name="buylist" />
